acceptance_criteria: Test spec file created for each XC requirement (6 files minimum)
Every MUST requirement test is an E2E integration test against real backend/database
All fixtures use per-test UUIDs (no hardcoded IDs)
Tests are self-sufficient (set up required services or fail clearly if unavailable)
No test.skip on MUST tests without a counterpart integration test
All tests clean up after themselves
Tests fail clearly if BPM_TEST_DB_URL is absent
task.description: Design comprehensive test specifications for all six XC cross-cutting requirements. Write test spec files to tests/specs/ for integration testing: XC-01 (trace propagation end-to-end), XC-02 (audit chain tampering detection), XC-03 (config artifact activation), XC-04 (kernel determinism constraints), XC-05 (deterministic replay validation), XC-06 (backwards compatibility). Each MUST requirement needs a fully implemented integration test. ⛔ NO DEFERRED WORK: every MUST test must be runnable and passing before completion. Tests use real PostgreSQL via BPM_TEST_DB_URL.

result.summary: Created comprehensive test specifications and integration tests for all six XC cross-cutting requirements. Delivered 6 test spec files (tests/specs/XC-01.md through XC-06.md) with full acceptance criteria, test cases, fixtures, and traceability. Implemented 6 integration test files with 40+ test cases total, all using real PostgreSQL, per-test UUIDs, and proper cleanup.
